<li class="blockList">
<hr>
<pre>public final class <span class="typeNameLabel">MapArrow</span>
extends <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-nativebase" title="class in com.here">NativeBase</a></pre>
<div class="block"><p>A visual representation of an arrow on the map. It consists of a tail - a polyline with an arbitrary
 number of points - and a head at its end.
 <p>The map arrows are only visible on zoom levels &gt;= 13.
 <p>Altitude component of <code>GeoPolyline</code>'s vertices is ignored.</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h4>MapArrow</h4>
<pre>public&nbsp;MapArrow&#8203;(@NonNull

                double&nbsp;widthInPixels,
                @NonNull
                <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-color" title="class in com.here.sdk.core">Color</a>&nbsp;color)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Creates a new <code>MapArrow</code> instance.
 <p>Altitude component of <code>GeoPolyline</code>'s vertices is ignored.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>geometry</code> - <p>The geometry of the arrow tail. The last coordinate in the list defines the position where the
     head of the arrow is located.</dd>
<dd><code>widthInPixels</code> - <p>The width of the arrow tail in pixel. Negative values are clamped to 0. The tip is scaled accordingly.</dd>
<dd><code>color</code> - <p>The color of the arrow. The alpha channel is ignored, the color is
     interpreted as fully opaque.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>

<li class="blockList"><a id="method.detail">

</a>
<h3>Method Detail</h3>
<a id="getMeasureDependentTailWidth()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getMeasureDependentTailWidth</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.Map&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasure</a>,&#8203;java.lang.Double&gt;&nbsp;getMeasureDependentTailWidth()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasure</code></a> dependent arrow tail width in pixels.
 <p>If tail width was configured without <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasure</code></a> dependency, then <code>measureDependentTailWidth</code>
 contains single entry with measure 0 of type <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure-kind#ZOOM_LEVEL"><code>MapMeasure.Kind.ZOOM_LEVEL</code></a> and width value
 equal to <code>widthInPixels</code>.
 <p>Note: This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected
 behavior. Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The width of the arrow tail in pixels, where the key is a <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasure</code></a> and the value is
     a tail width in pixels at this <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasure</code></a>.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="setMeasureDependentTailWidth(java.util.Map)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>setMeasureDependentTailWidth</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;void&nbsp;setMeasureDependentTailWidth&#8203;(@NonNull
                                         java.util.Map&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasure</a>,&#8203;java.lang.Double&gt;&nbsp;value)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Sets the <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasure</code></a> dependent arrow tail width in pixels.
 <p>The width values are linearly interpolated between nearest map entries.
 Width values for <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasure</code></a> outside the map entries are kept constant, using the
 value of the largest/smallest key.
 <p>Only <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasure</code></a> of <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure-kind#ZOOM_LEVEL"><code>MapMeasure.Kind.ZOOM_LEVEL</code></a> type is supported.
 Other <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasure</code></a> types are unsupported and hence, will be ignored.
 <p>Map with a single entry is equivalent to use of the <code>widthInPixels</code> value
 in the constructor, so a constant width setting, independent of camera.
 <p>Empty input is ignored and existing width is maintained.
 <p>The width values should be positive. Map entries with width values less than or equal to 0 are ignored.
 <p>Note: This is a beta release of this feature, so there could be a few bugs and unexpected
 behavior. Related APIs may change for new releases without a deprecation process.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>value</code> - <p>The width of the arrow tail in pixels, where the key is a <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasure</code></a> and the value is
     a tail width in pixels at this <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapMeasure</code></a>.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="getVisibilityRanges()">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockList">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>getVisibilityRanges</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">@NonNull
public&nbsp;java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasurerange" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureRange</a>&gt;&nbsp;getVisibilityRanges()</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Gets the list of visibility ranges.
 <p>A range is half-open - [minimumZoomLevel, maximumZoomLevel), the given maximum value
 is not contained in the range.
 <p>When empty (the default), the map arrows are visible without map measure restrictions.
 Only <code>MapMeasureRange</code>(s) of <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure-kind#ZOOM_LEVEL"><code>MapMeasure.Kind.ZOOM_LEVEL</code></a> type are supported.
 <code>MapMeasureRange</code>(s) of other unsupported types will be ignored.}</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="returnLabel">Returns:</span></dt>
<dd><p>The list of visibility ranges, in which the map arrow is visible.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
<a id="setVisibilityRanges(java.util.List)">
<!--   -->
</a>
<ul class="blockListLast">
<li class="blockList">
<h4>setVisibilityRanges</h4>
<pre class="methodSignature">public&nbsp;void&nbsp;setVisibilityRanges&#8203;(@NonNull
                                java.util.List&lt;<a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasurerange" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview">MapMeasureRange</a>&gt;&nbsp;value)</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Sets visibility ranges for this map arrow.
 <p>A range is half-open - [minimumZoomLevel, maximumZoomLevel), the given maximum value
 is not contained in the range.
 <p>When empty (the default), the map arrows are visible without map measure restrictions.
 Only <code>MapMeasureRange</code>(s) of <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapmeasure-kind#ZOOM_LEVEL"><code>MapMeasure.Kind.ZOOM_LEVEL</code></a> type are supported.
 <code>MapMeasureRange</code>(s) of other unsupported types will be ignored.}</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="paramLabel">Parameters:</span></dt>
<dd><code>value</code> - <p>The list of visibility ranges, in which the map arrow is visible.</dd>
</dl>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
</section>
</li>
</ul>
